questions: Should the histogram bars be placed at integer positions (indexes) as in the reference solution, or should they be centered on the labels? The width parameter might affect spacing.
If the input list contains non-string items (e.g., numbers, None), should they be converted to strings, ignored, or raise an error?
How should duplicate items within a single sublist be counted? Are they counted separately or deduplicated per sublist?
What should happen if the input list is empty (e.g., [] or [[]])? Should it return an empty plot, raise an error, or something else?
Is the x-axis sorting strictly alphabetical (lexicographic) based on default string ordering, or should it use locale-aware sorting?
Should the histogram use a fixed bar width relative to the spacing between bars, or should width be interpreted as a fraction of the available space?
If there are many distinct items, should the plot automatically adjust figure size or x-tick rotation to avoid label overlap?
Are the menu items expected to be ASCII-only, or should Unicode strings be handled? Does sorting handle Unicode correctly?
